comparison.objective: Scoop at least five beads from a tray into a bowl; candidate separates ceramic media from larger washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Both handle collections of loose bodies, but bead transfer requires selecting and loading a scoop against a tray wall, whereas the candidate requires bimanual screen motion and selective aperture passage.
comparison.success_condition: Delivered-bead count with a 1 s settled hold; candidate measures ≥98% target mass while requiring every washer retained, screen reseated, hands clear, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Bulk collection and transfer does not test two-class separation; the bead rubric lacks a release gate and explicit spill/damage penalties, but that gap does not create a plausible duplicate.
